nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group lets you refine features by automating the masking process.
🔹 Select 'true' for face swap (🥸) or 'false' for auto detailer (🧙).
🔹 Select 'true' to enable swapping (🎭) or 'false' to restore face only.
🔹 Select 'true' to swap 1 face (👤) or 'false' to swap 2 faces (👥).
🔹 Face swap (🥸) uses a detection model to identify faces, crops them with a bounding box, 
switches the faces with a swap model, and masks them with a segmentation model.
🔹 Auto detailer (🧙) uses a detection model to identify features (faces, hands...), 
crops them with a bounding box, upscales them, masks them with a segmentation model, 
inpaints them, scales them back down, and stitches them back over the original image.
Select the LoRA to add to the text
Select the Wildcard to add to the text
